title: lachemilla adscendens
intro: Lachemilla adscendens, commonly known as creeping lachemilla or rock pipewort, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the family Rosaceae. It is primarily used as an herbal remedy due to its health benefits, including its ability to soothe digestive issues and reduce inflammation. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which make it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lachemilla adscendens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
